Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can lock a short product intro (30 min):

Recap / qualification highlights
- Main use case: reduce triage time for inbound claims using embeddings + reranking.
- Primary success metric: 20–30% faster first-response time for claims team.
- Data: HIPAA-adjacent; customer will require VPC/private option for PHI in longer term.
- Technical constraints: 2–3 second tail latency target for the query path; volume ~50k reqs/day.

Next step: 30-min product intro (demo + high-level integration notes). Soo Jin (cc'd) will cover the technical bits. To minimize scheduling round trips, please pick one of these 3 short windows (all PT):

1) Thu, Sep 2 — 10:00–10:30am PT
2) Fri, Sep 3 — 1:00–1:30pm PT
3) Mon, Sep 6 — 11:30am–12:00pm PT

Attached: 30min-demo-agenda.pdf (sample agenda + prep asks).

Would you prefer any of the above? If none work, reply with two times that do and we'll accommodate. Also confirm who from your side should attend (ops/eng/product).

Thanks —
